messages:
Maria-partners: Heads up — EdgeRack rejected PO PO-ER-1102 due to billing entity/tax-id mismatch, customer NimbusRetail stuck.
Owen-sales: Customer asking for delivery ETA, this is a $320k order. Any quick unblock?
Vendor-AM: EdgeRack portal error: INVALID_BILLING_ENTITY, registry tax_id=12-3456780 vs PO tax_id=12-3456789. They won't accept until names/tax match.
Tracy-legal: We can provide a capped attestation. Need finance approval for indemnity cap.
Leo-ops: Quick ops option: manual vendor acceptance request to EdgeRack AM while we sort data sync. I can open ticket now.
Maria-partners: Please do. Also run a vendor-registry sync — could be a stale record.
Marketplace-bot: System: PO-ER-1102 moved to validation_failed at 2026-03-22T12:01:11Z, code=INVALID_BILLING_ENTITY
Leo-ops: Registry sync ran — found a trailing-zero formatting difference. Recon job mapping MBP-881 -> VBE-1093.
Tracy-legal: Attestation draft posted, finance approved capped indemnity. Posting link in DM to EdgeRack AM.
Vendor-AM: EdgeRack confirmed manual acceptance upon receiving attestation. They'll hold delivery slot 48h.
Owen-sales: Notifying NimbusRetail; they appreciate faster handling.
Maria-partners: Closing — follow-ups: add tolerant tax-id validator, include registry sync in weekly runbook, and schedule partner sync with EdgeRack.
